name: Academic Integrity
description: Teaches learners paraphrasing, quotation, attribution, and plagiarism avoidance skills for academic writing. Produces practice exercises and self-checks for maintaining academic integrity -- not a policy document. Use when a learner asks about avoiding plagiarism, learning to paraphrase, understanding citation requirements, or practicing attribution in academic writing. Do NOT use for citation format specifics (use `citation-management`), for writing the paper itself (use writing category skills), or for institutional policy questions (refer to their institution).
